24. Deadlock Conditions

The four necessary conditions for classical resource deadlock are mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait,
no preemption and circular wait.

# Pseudocode: consistent lock order
lock(A); lock(B)
work()
unlock(B); unlock(A)
Expected result: A universal A-before-B policy removes circular wait for these locks.

Q: How can a deadlock be prevented?
A: Break at least one necessary condition, e.g. enforce lock ordering.
